Classify one panel membership pattern

Source: R/panel-describe.R
dot-classify_panel_pattern.Rd

Internal helper used by panel_composition().

Usage

.classify_panel_pattern(obs_years, panel_years)

Arguments

obs_years

Sorted unique years observed for one ID.

panel_years

Sorted unique years in the full panel.

Value

A list containing panel_type ("persistent", "entrant", "exit", "transient", or "empty"), spell_balance ("seamless" or "segmented"), and gap counts.
